fa1382d1895048d17d023f6de4e3cc2ccd982316.summary: Archived index page of the Group-IB blog, listing many posts from 2019 to 2026 with titles, categories, dates and author names. Topics include malware, phishing kits, ransomware, APT groups and fraud, mixed with vendor product announcements. It lists articles rather than analysing one threat, so no facts are recorded.

fa5574d55e4505e039fec0718f656574634341b9.summary: A BleepingComputer article published 2024-08-12 reports that South Korea's ruling People Power Party claims North Korean hackers stole technical data on the K2 tank and the Baekdu and Geumgang spy planes. The report says K2 data may have leaked when engineers moved to a competing company, and that a defense contractor producing manuals for the spy planes was hacked. South Korean police warned in April 2024 that Lazarus, Andariel and Kimsuky were targeting defense firms, and said DPRK operatives had compromised multiple companies since late 2022.
